name: io.github.ChoYugyeong/shearwater
title: Shearwater
description: Approved, verified deploys for AI agents: one delegated app, one approved plan, HTTP proof.

packageArguments.name: --workflow
packageArguments.description: Absolute path of the work.json an operator created with `sw task create` for one app. It carries the app, the allowed actions and a token that expires.

packageArguments.name: --allow-write
packageArguments.description: Let the agent plan deploy/update/recover. Plans still stop at awaiting_approval until the operator approves the exact hash. Omit for read-only status and verify.
